basis: Ciliary dysfunction causes chronic airway disease; chronic middle-ear disease with hearing impairment affects roughly 50% or more in PCD; subtype-specific frequency is uncertain.
Skin blistering and pyloric atresia define this subtype; oral and esophageal lesions reinforce GI involvement. Microtia in one patient does not establish common functional ear damage.
Bile acid synthesis defects are metabolic disorders, predominantly cholestatic. Neurologic disease is subtype-dependent; malabsorption does not establish direct intestinal damage.
Neuroendocrine tumor arising in autonomic paraganglia. Nonsecreting definition overrides conflicting catecholamine-related HPO; additional organ injury is site-dependent.
Defined by a congenital atrial septal defect; reported associated defects are cardiac. Broader GATA4-related pancreatic disease is not established for this subtype.
Chondroid hamartomas most commonly arise in lung, but this record specifies histology without an anatomical site; pulmonary assignment is provisional.
Neoplasm directly involving the myocardium; no additional organ involvement is established.
Cerebellar degeneration and neurodevelopmental impairment define SCAR2. Eye-movement abnormalities are neurologic; weakness and hypotonia do not establish primary muscle damage.
Meningeal tumor at the tuberculum sellae; direct optic nerve/chiasm compression causes visual impairment in roughly 70–90%. Skull-base location alone does not establish bone damage.
Limb and craniofacial skeletal malformations define disease; gingival overgrowth, bifid tongue and malocclusion occur in 30–79%. Facial appearance alone does not establish ocular damage.
